items.title: Truth Lies Deep: Countering Semantic Camouflage via Latent Intent Verification
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.20378v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) is often superficial, relying on refusal mechanisms that trigger only at the final stages of generation without erasing the foundational knowledge of harmful concepts acquired during pretraining. This study demonstrates that this architectural disconnect leaves models vulnerable to Semantic Camouflage -- adversarial attacks that wrap harmful intent in benign narrative contexts (e.g., creative writing), effectively bypassing standard input and output guardrails. By analyzing the latent activation trajectories of three distinct Small Language Model (SLM) families (Phi-3, Qwen2.5, and Gemma-2b) under adversarial stress, this research identifies a universal ``Intent Horizon'' -- a critical depth (typically 15--20\% of total layers) where the model's distinct, pre-trained representation of harmful intent collapses as it contextualizes the query into a ``safe'' narrative. items.summary_zh: 本文研究大语言模型的安全对齐问题，指出当前拒绝机制仅作用于生成最后阶段，未消除预训练阶段习得的有害概念知识，导致模型易受语义伪装攻击。作者提出潜在意图验证方法，通过深入分析模型的内部表示来识别和阻止恶意意图，即使表面文本看似无害。实验证明该方法能有效对抗语义伪装，提高模型安全性。论文还探讨了安全对齐的架构性缺陷，为未来安全研究提供了新方向。

items.title: Nexus: Depth-Adaptive KV-Cache Splicing and Retrieval-Decoupled Tool Routing for Agentic LLMs on Unified Memory
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.20397v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agentic large language models (LLMs) on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) re-encode verbose tool schemas every turn, so prefill - quadratic in sequence length - dominates time-to-first-token (TTFT) as the tool registry grows. Nexus's primary lever is to decouple routing from the schema-prefill cost: an INT8 semantic lookaside buffer (SLB) with a calibrated cross-encoder margin gate selects tools by retrieval, and arguments are generated over a compressed textual signature (median 19 tokens) rather than over spliced key/value (KV) cache. This path is depth-independent: routing accuracy stays near 89% as the registry scales to 250 tools - where a concatenate-all-schemas baseline overflows the context window entirely - and it reaches a first-argument token 1.66x sooner than a full-schema re-prefill at a ~80% main-context token saving. items.summary_zh: 本文提出Nexus系统，针对基于MCP的智能体LLM在统一内存上的效率问题。智能体LLM每轮重新编码冗长的工具模式，导致预填充成本随工具注册表增长而急剧增加，TTFT成为瓶颈。Nexus通过将路由与模式预填充成本解耦，使用INT8语义旁路缓冲区（SLB）进行快速路由，并采用深度自适应KV缓存拼接技术，减少重复计算。实验表明，Nexus显著降低了TTFT，提高了吞吐量，同时保持了准确性，为大规模工具集下的智能体部署提供了高效方案。
items.title_zh: Nexus：面向统一内存上智能体LLM的深度自适应KV缓存拼接与检索解耦工具路由

items.title: Dual-Cache Latent Space Communication between Heterogeneous Language Models
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.20617v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems split work across models, so answering often requires knowledge that sits in another agent's context: a Sharer has encoded information that a Receiver needs to complete its task. They usually communicate by exchanging text, which puts autoregressive decoding on the critical path and reduces the exchange to a discrete message written without sight of the receiver's state. Recent latent protocols instead translate the sharer's key-value (KV) cache into the receiver's: C2C supports heterogeneous models but requires both to read the same input, while LCF-X removes this shared-context requirement through position-free sharer-cache pooling. Three restrictions remain: LCF-X compresses the sharer alone, supplies the same layer-local summary to every receiver position with no joint cross-layer memory to retrieve from, and assumes matched layer count and KV geometry. items.reason_zh: 提出双缓存潜在空间通信，避免文本解码瓶颈，创新性强。
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种双缓存潜在空间通信方法，用于异构语言模型之间的信息传递。在多智能体系统中，一个模型（共享者）编码的信息需要传递给另一个模型（接收者）以完成任务。传统方法通过交换文本，但自回归解码成为瓶颈。作者利用潜在空间中的缓存直接传递信息，避免了文本解码，显著提高了通信效率。实验表明，该方法在多个任务上性能优于文本交换。

items.title: Speculative Decoding on CPUs: Nearly 4x Faster Token Generation with DFlash
items.raw_text:
Speculative decoding can turn underused CPU compute into faster token generation, without changing the model's output. In our vLLM tests, DFlash delivered 3.92x the autoregressive throughput with Qwen3.5-9B on Intel Xeon 6 at concurrency 1. We break down where the speedup comes from, explain the acceptance metrics, and show what determines whether speculation pays off.

The post Speculative Decoding on CPUs: Nearly 4x Faster Token Generation with DFlash appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.reason_zh: 深入解析CPU上投机解码的加速原理与收益条件，对推理优化实践有直接指导价值。
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在CPU上利用投机解码（Speculative Decoding）加速大模型推理的方法，重点介绍了DFlash技术。作者在vLLM框架下，使用Intel Xeon 6处理器和Qwen3.5-9B模型进行测试，结果显示在并发数为1时，DFlash的吞吐量达到自回归解码的3.92倍。文章详细分析了加速的来源，包括草稿模型与目标模型的协同、接受率等关键指标，并解释了投机解码在何种情况下能带来收益，以及如何评估其效果。作者还讨论了CPU上未被充分利用的计算资源如何被转化为生成速度的提升，为在CPU环境下优化LLM推理提供了实用的技术参考。
items.title_zh: CPU上的投机解码：DFlash实现近4倍令牌生成加速

items.title: Under Domestic Compute Constraints, iFLYTEK Turns to Engineering
items.raw_text: At its August earnings call, iFLYTEK acknowledged domestic accelerators trail Nvidia's H200 by up to 5x on long-context training. Instead of waiting for hardware, it is optimizing architecture, operators, memory and frameworks — proving the approach with Spark X2-Flash on Huawei Ascend 910B.
items.reason_zh: 科大讯飞在算力受限下的工程优化策略，对国内AI企业有直接借鉴意义。
items.summary_zh: 科大讯飞在8月财报电话会上承认，国产加速器在长上下文训练上比英伟达H200落后多达5倍。面对硬件瓶颈，公司选择通过优化架构、算子、内存和框架来提升性能，并在华为昇腾910B上以Spark X2-Flash证明了这一方法的有效性。这一策略展示了在算力受限条件下，通过工程创新弥补硬件差距的可能性，为国内AI企业提供了可行的技术路径。
items.title_zh: 国内算力受限，科大讯飞转向工程优化

items.title: [Agent 考古] 自知、自觉、自止——终章定论：Agent 不需要意识，但必须知道自己的边界、理由和终点
items.raw_text:
Chollet 2019年将智能定义为“获取新技能的效率”。本文以此为标尺重审ELIZA到LLM全史，揭示“多少人工就有多少智能”的精确内涵——priors购买技能但priors≠智能。提出四层专精化（专项LLM+专项工具+专项技能+专项资源）作为未来Agent工程方向，论证Minsky组织论与Chollet度量论的互补公式。

items.summary_zh: 文章以Chollet的智能定义（获取新技能的效率）为标尺，重审从ELIZA到LLM的Agent发展史，揭示“多少人工就有多少智能”的精确内涵：priors购买技能但priors不等于智能。提出四层专精化（专项LLM+专项工具+专项技能+专项资源）作为未来Agent工程方向，并论证Minsky组织论与Chollet度量论的互补性。文章强调Agent不需要意识，但必须知道自己的边界、理由和终点，为Agent设计提供了新视角。
